name: v2-absolute-relative
covers: G90/G91 positioning and G92 coordinate reset
review: At 80 steps/mm the six signed motor changes and final (1600,800,0) agree with G90/G91 and the motionless G92 coordinate reset. Source-defined junction deviation and independently calculated move vectors reproduce the boundary speeds. Tick-rounded integration predicts each block's final pulse within three 10 microsecond ticks, including the previously unresolved second move. Both real firmware revisions reproduced the trace; board timing remains unverified.
